lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You're going to want to see this.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: A message. Encrypted through a dead-drop network I thought I'd burned years ago.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Coordinates to Thalassa-5. And one word: "Takeshi."

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Your son.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Recruited into the Dominion at twelve. Silent for eight years. But someone got a message out.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: These coordinates are the first sign he's still breathing.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: We set course now.

lines.speaker: Bartender
lines.text: You're looking for something specific, and you're carrying the weight of it like a wound.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Abyssal Vault. What do you know about operations down there?

lines.speaker: Bartender
lines.text: The Vault is a prison and a market both. Prisoners are value, and value is extracted.

lines.speaker: Bartender
lines.text: They flood the cells twice daily. Drowning near to death and revival, over and over, until the prisoners' memory barriers collapse. What's inside gets sold. Everything extracted flows through the Hollow Kings' network.

lines.speaker: Bartender
lines.text: What remains of the prisoners gets recycled as programmable labor. Work until expiration. Efficient.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: How deep?

lines.speaker: Bartender
lines.text: Two kilometers beneath the ice, tethered to thermal vents. Corridors are built to flood and drain on a tidal cycle. Prisoners don't climb out. They're already beneath the drowning.

lines.speaker: Tide Baron Enforcer
lines.text: Kessler. I remember you.

lines.speaker: Tide Baron Enforcer
lines.text: The old debt. From the runoff years. Still outstanding.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That debt's been paid through channels...

lines.speaker: Enforcer 1
lines.text: Multiple contacts! Detainment protocol!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: We're out of time. We move now or we're trapped here.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Takeshi was taken when he was twelve.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Dominion's recruiters came to his school. They said he had augmentation markers. Potential. I tried to stop them.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: They took him anyway.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The Barons declared his departure a "compensable debt." A boy with operative markers is valuable merchandise. I would have had to pay or lose him.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I chose to disappear instead. I've been paying in other ways ever since.

lines.speaker: Prisoner-Worker
lines.text: You move like an operative.

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: Seven.

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: You came.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: How do you know that designation?

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: Because my father told me about you before they took me.

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: He said when I was scared I should remember a soldier who chose mercy over mission. He said you were the only operative they ever couldn't make kill children.

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: The Barons said you were dead. But I never believed it.

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: How did you know to come?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Your father sent a message. One word. That was enough.

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: Because I'm the only operative who ever chose someone over the mission.

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: No. You're the only operative who chose my father. And that was the whole choice.

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: The Dominion's failsafe leaves a neural signature in every operative who ever walked out of the program.

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: A latticework connecting chip to handler to command hub. Every operative networked to the next.

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: By extracting from enough operatives over enough years, the Vault built a complete map. The full reach of the network. How many operatives are connected. How the routing flows through Dominion command infrastructure.

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: They have that map now. The Barons sold it to two major buyers. The network is no longer a secret the Dominion controls alone.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: And you.

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: Tomorrow they plan to extract my memories of you. Of your defection. To sell as proof that the conditioning can break. To sell that crack in the architecture to anyone desperate enough to pay.

lines.speaker: Researcher 1
lines.text: Specimen is mobile! Override containment!

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: Seventeen prisoners remain in the Vault. All operatives. All still alive.

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: If containment fails, the standard protocol is a full-structure flood. Kill the evidence. No survivors. No proof.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Where are the emergency bulkhead controls?

lines.speaker: Takeshi
lines.text: Three sectors down. The command core. Below the research floor.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: I've watched you since you entered the Vault.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: I joined the Tide Barons for deep-sea research. For the study of bioluminescence and neural adaptation in high-pressure environments.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: I did not join to watch the Vault become what it became.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: The command core access code. Use it.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Why would you give me this?

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: Because the Dominion doesn't care about justice. They care about efficiency. The Barons don't care about the prisoners. They care about profit. And I have decided I will care about neither.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: After this, I am done with the Tide Barons. I want passage from the Dominion's reach.

lines.speaker: Defense System (Overhead)
lines.text: Intruder neutralized by automated defense. Initiate containment protocol.

lines.speaker: Commodore
lines.text: The Tide Barons have never exploited weakness in operatives.

lines.speaker: Commodore
lines.text: Weakness is unreliable. It breaks in unpredictable ways.

lines.speaker: Commodore
lines.text: Strength is what we exploit. The capacity for connection. For compassion. The flaw that makes operatives useful to anyone who understands it.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: The Vault's full extraction records. Every operative transferred. Every memory extracted. Every price paid.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: I copied everything before the collapse. The originals are wiped. No second copy exists.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: I'm done with the Barons.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You have passage. Welcome aboard.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: The network map was sold to at least two external buyers before I wiped the Vault's original records.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: One buyer paid in currency used only by organizations working to dismantle the Dominion from outside.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: That might be you, eventually.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: The archive contains everything the Vault extracted from operatives over the past seven years.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: Alongside the network map, there are the Vault's procurement records. Every operative transferred in. Dates of capture. Last Dominion contact recorded. Status at transfer.

lines.speaker: Sable Dross
lines.text: These entries are different. Not dead. Not broken. But struck from the Dominion's own records as though they never existed.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: This is only the Vault's copy.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Somewhere in the Dominion, there is a master ledger. Every operative they ever built. Every one they erased. A complete accounting of what they made and then unmade.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The Dominion built us and erased us when we stopped being useful.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: If there is a master ledger, every name they struck from the record, then there are people who don't know they're still on someone's list. Or still alive enough to matter.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: We find that ledger. And we make sure no one else forgets what the Dominion tried to erase.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Takeshi is alive. Sable Dross is aboard with the Vault's full records.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: And somewhere there's a master ledger naming every operative they erased. We find it next.
